name: New-episode alerts
description: Sends a message to Discord, email or any webhook when new movies and episodes arrive — one tidy message per scan.
author: NodeFlix

settings.label: Discord webhook URL
settings.help: In Discord: channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy URL.

settings.label: Other webhook URL (JSON POST)
settings.help: For Home Assistant, n8n, ntfy and similar. Receives { event, server, text, items }.

settings.label: Email to
settings.help: One or more addresses, separated by commas.

settings.label: Email from
settings.help: Usually the address you sign in to the mail server with.

options.label: None (only for a mail relay on your own network)

settings.label: Mail password
settings.help: Gmail and Outlook need an app password here, not your normal password.

settings.label: Your NodeFlix address (for links)
settings.help: e.g. https://media.example.com — leave empty to send without links.

settings.label: Stay quiet on a library's first scan (so adding a big library doesn't spam everyone)
